single_turn_input.text: Review the attached contract against the 'Procurement Clean Standard' policy (procurement_clean). Report every violation (the broken rule, the offending text span when the clause is present, and a short rationale), list any clauses needing human review, and give an overall compliant verdict.

All deviations from the Specifications must be approved by CUTANEA, in writing, prior to Supplier Manufacturing the Product."]}, {"category": "Minimum Commitment", "rule": "must_not_have", "present": true, "evidence_spans": ["Supplier will use commercially reasonable efforts to deliver Product to CUTANEA with minimum expiry dating remaining of [***]% of the approved shelf-life."]}], "needs_review": []}
